**No actionable findings** · [11bb2202e539](https://github.com/modelscope/evalscope/pull/2169/commits/11bb2202e5392f46897037efed952f7450a3ed80) · 2026-11-21 22:59:54 UTC · [Actions run](https://github.com/modelscope/evalscope/actions/runs/44959392248)

**High-confidence findings:** 0
**Inline:** 0 · **Summary-only:** 0

No high-confidence finding was established in the fixed diff. The change makes `Text2SpeechAPI._generate_openai_audio` accept an `Optional[GenerateConfig]` (defaulted, so existing call sites remain compatible), merges `config.extra_headers` into the OpenAI-compatible request headers via `get_secret_value`, and passes `config.extra_query` as the requests `params`; the Volcengine path is untouched. The trigger is plausible and EvalScope-local: the OpenAI TTS branch previously built headers only through `_openai_headers()` and never read `extra_headers`/`extra_query`, so gateway headers or query parameters (for example `api-version`) were silently dropped, while other EvalScope model paths already forward them; the per-call `config` is now threaded from `generate`, which gives a concrete benefit with no change when the fields are unset. Behavior checks against the visible diff: the positional third argument matches the new defaulted parameter, `params` is only added when `extra_query` is truthy (so the pre-existing OpenAI mock that does not accept `params` is unaffected), an `extra_headers` entry overrides the default headers while `Authorization` is preserved when not overridden, and the new mock test exercises header merge, bearer preservation, and query mapping. Unverified or missing context: both changed-file sources are truncated (`contextCoverage.sourcesTruncated=2`), so `get_secret_value`'s exact behavior, the declared types/defaults of `GenerateConfig.extra_headers` and `extra_query`, `_openai_headers`, `_init_openai`, `_collect_openai_audio`, and the model wrapper's config-merging logic could not be inspected; it is therefore unverified that `get_secret_value` always returns a mapping for the header update and that construction-time config reliably reaches `generate` outside the added test. I did not execute `pytest` or run CI; the author's '3 passed' statement and the workflow-verified CI status are author/workflow evidence, not checks I performed. No official-protocol divergence is claimed. Remaining checks for a human: confirm header state cannot persist across requests if `_openai_headers()` ever returns shared instance state rather than a fresh dict, and confirm the new test is collected by the default test configuration.
